craft_evidence.reasoning: FARM Rio dates and places its founding (Rio, 1997) and publishes a Tier 1 supplier map via Open Supply Hub, but no product page names a maker, mill or even a country. A published supplier list is checkable making at the brand level; if that counts as 'names its makers', this is a 3 — flagged for the ruling.
